faqs.a:
The board shall designate an actuary who shall be technical adviser to the board on
               matters regarding the operation of the retirement system on an actuarial basis and
               who shall perform such other duties as are required in connection therewith. The pension
               fund shall be responsible for payment of any costs incurred therein.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(H); Code 1981, § 26-30)
